Initial release: Automatically generates and publishes articles to Douyin (TikTok China).

- Generates engaging markdown articles and AI-created cover images for any user-specified topic.
- Publishes content to Douyin using the sau command-line tool.
- Supports various content categories like technology, lifestyle, education, entertainment, and business.
- Designed to automate and streamline the Douyin article publishing workflow for content creators.
